verdict.rationale: Dover's own Job Boards tab posts a job to LinkedIn, Indeed, or ZipRecruiter in a few clicks. Edits propagate to the careers page and to any connected job boards, so the multi-board fan-out from inside the ATS is documented. Nothing in the pack shows sponsored or paid-post management, and coverage of aggregators beyond these three boards is not shown. missing for 10: sponsored-post/budget management inside the ATS, broader aggregator distribution, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, one posting fans out to the job boards — LinkedIn, Indeed, and the aggregators — with sponsored-post management from inside the ATS

citations.quote: Open the **Job Boards** tab of a job and post to LinkedIn, Indeed, or ZipRecruiter in a few clicks.
Changes appear on your posting, your careers page, and on any job boards connected to Dover.
